eridu-settled-sumer.research_focus: Ubaid-period settlement at Eridu, reed and mudbrick huts, marsh and river irrigation in southern Mesopotamia
eridu-settled-sumer.scene: Farmers in simple woven tunics build small mudbrick and reed houses on a low rise at the edge of a marsh, with irrigation ditches and grain plots stretching toward the water

uruk-first-city-walled.research_focus: Late Uruk period Uruk: temple platforms, mudbrick walls, clay-cone mosaic decoration, dense urban housing
uruk-first-city-walled.scene: A crowded mudbrick city seen from a rooftop, with a great temple on a raised platform above packed flat-roofed houses, porters carrying grain and a long defensive wall beyond

cuneiform-writing-emerges.research_focus: Uruk IV proto-cuneiform tablets, scribes with reed styluses, counting of grain and beer
cuneiform-writing-emerges.scene: A scribe kneeling beside baskets of grain presses a reed stylus into a small wet clay tablet held in one palm, rows of finished tablets drying on a mat beside him

royal-tombs-of-ur.research_focus: Woolley's Royal Cemetery at Ur: lyres with bull heads, gold leaf headdresses, shaft tombs
royal-tombs-of-ur.scene: Inside a mudbrick burial chamber, a bull-headed lyre and a delicate gold leaf headdress lie among beads and cups beside a bier, lit from a ramp of daylight, with no one shown in distress

urukagina-reforms-lagash.research_focus: Early Dynastic Lagash under Urukagina, temple estates, officials, widows and the poor, a clay cone proclamation
urukagina-reforms-lagash.scene: A king in a fringed sheepskin skirt stands among a crowd of poor farmers and a widow with her children, while temple officials step back from heaped goods they have been forced to give up

enheduanna-hymns-inanna.research_focus: Enheduanna, high priestess of the moon god at Ur, her calcite disc, Inanna imagery, Akkadian-period priestess dress
enheduanna-hymns-inanna.scene: A priestess in a layered fringed robe and tall headdress sits composing at a clay tablet in a temple courtyard at dusk, a star-and-lion emblem of the goddess Inanna carved on the wall behind her

naram-sin-victory-stele.research_focus: Akkadian rock-cut and stele victory imagery, horned helmet, mountain climb, fallen Lullubi enemies
naram-sin-victory-stele.scene: A tall carved stone stele shows a king in a horned helmet climbing a steep mountain above fallen enemies, with soldiers climbing in file below and stars overhead

elamites-sack-ur.research_focus: Ur III ziggurat of Ur-Nammu, Elamite warriors from the Iranian plateau, end of the Third Dynasty of Ur
elamites-sack-ur.scene: Foreign raiders in felt caps lead a bound king away on a causeway toward a stepped ziggurat, while smoke rises over the mudbrick city behind them; non-graphic, no fighting shown

amorite-dynasty-babylon.research_focus: Old Babylonian period beginnings, Amorite tribal leader, small town on the Euphrates, mudbrick walls
amorite-dynasty-babylon.scene: A tribal chieftain in a long fringed wool cloak stands with his followers and sheep at the gate of a small mudbrick river town, a modest canal and palm trees beyond

plimpton-322-tablet.research_focus: Old Babylonian mathematical tablets, sexagesimal numbers, right triangles, scribal school
plimpton-322-tablet.scene: A young scribe in a school room traces a right triangle in wet clay with a stylus, a half-finished clay tablet beside him, with a larger broken tablet of ruled columns on the bench; the tablet is shown as an object only

code-of-hammurabi-carved.research_focus: Hammurabi's basalt stele, relief of the king before the sun god Shamash, Old Babylonian stone carving
code-of-hammurabi-carved.scene: Stonecutters with chisels carve a tall rounded basalt pillar, its top relief showing a king standing before a seated god, while a crowd of townspeople gathers to look at the finished face

hittites-sack-babylon.research_focus: Mursili I's raid on Babylon in 1595 BC, Hittite chariots and soldiers, the statue of Marduk taken as plunder
hittites-sack-babylon.scene: Hittite soldiers with pointed caps carry a large gilded statue of a god out of a mudbrick temple gate on poles, as smoke drifts over the city and a chariot waits; non-graphic

ashur-uballit-frees-assyria.research_focus: Middle Assyrian court of Ashur-uballit I, diplomatic clay tablets, gift exchange with Egypt, Ashur city
ashur-uballit-frees-assyria.scene: An Assyrian king in a tall rounded crown receives an envoy carrying a rolled gold gift box in his audience hall, while a messenger holds a clay tablet letter, the city walls of Ashur visible through an arch

gilgamesh-epic-standard-version.research_focus: Neo-Assyrian and late Babylonian libraries, scribe copying tablets of the Epic of Gilgamesh, the flood story
gilgamesh-epic-standard-version.scene: A scribe writes by lamplight at a desk heaped with clay tablets, while a painted frieze on the wall behind shows a bearded hero wrestling a lion and a boat riding a flood

ashurnasirpal-builds-nimrud.research_focus: Neo-Assyrian Kalhu (Nimrud), Northwest Palace, winged human-headed bull guardians, banquet feast
ashurnasirpal-builds-nimrud.scene: Long tables heaped with bread, roast meat and jars of beer stand in a vast palace courtyard flanked by carved winged bulls with human heads, guests in fringed robes seated in rows as servants carry platters

babylonian-astronomical-diaries.research_focus: Babylonian temple astronomers on a ziggurat, observing planets and the moon, recording on clay tablets
babylonian-astronomical-diaries.scene: Priest-astronomers on the stepped roof of a ziggurat at night point at a crescent moon and a bright planet, one pressing marks into a clay tablet by lamplight

tiglath-pileser-iii-reforms.research_focus: Tiglath-Pileser III's army reforms, Neo-Assyrian standing army, armoured infantry and cavalry, provincial governors
tiglath-pileser-iii-reforms.scene: A stern bearded king in a tall crown watches disciplined ranks of scale-armoured infantry and mounted archers drill in formation on a plain, a governor with a tablet standing beside him

sennacherib-palace-nineveh.research_focus: Sennacherib's Palace Without Rival at Nineveh, gardens, the Jerwan aqueduct, Assyrian relief carving
sennacherib-palace-nineveh.scene: A grand terraced palace with a long colonnaded facade rises above a garden of trees watered by a stone aqueduct crossing a valley, laborers hauling a colossal winged bull on a sledge in the foreground

ashurbanipal-takes-throne.research_focus: Ashurbanipal as crown prince trained as scribe and warrior, Neo-Assyrian court at Nineveh, lion hunts and writing tablets
ashurbanipal-takes-throne.scene: A young Assyrian king in a tall crown stands between a stack of clay tablets and a bow with a quiver of arrows, courtiers bowing in the palace hall behind him

nebuchadnezzar-wins-carchemish.research_focus: Battle of Carchemish 605 BC, Babylonian army, Egyptian and Assyrian remnant troops, Euphrates citadel
nebuchadnezzar-wins-carchemish.scene: Babylonian chariots and spearmen charge across a river plain toward a hilltop citadel on the Euphrates as Egyptian soldiers break and retreat; a young prince in scale armour commands from a chariot, non-graphic
